turnaround_reason: Broadband subscriber losses to fixed-wireless and fiber overbuilders cut the stock nearly in half from ~$286 to ~$150. The bet is that FCF, aggressive buybacks, mobile growth, and the pending Liberty Broadband merger stabilize the story even if internet subs keep bleeding.
bullish_points: Extreme cheapness: trailing P/E ~3.9, forward P/E ~3.4, EV/EBITDA ~5.5 for a business still generating ~$2.2B FCF and $16B operating cash flow
Heavy insider buying over last 6m: net +1.58M shares across 21 purchase transactions incl. CEO Winfrey (~$1.4M) and multiple directors buying $1M+ blocks near $140-175
Aggressive capital return: ~$963M buyback in Q1 2026 (~4% of cap) plus a standing $100M/month repurchase from Liberty Broadband until the merger closes
Mobile is a real growth engine: +406k lines in Q2 to 12.5M total, enabling convergence/bundling as a broadband-defense lever (incl. SpaceX/satellite talks)
51.6% short interest of float against a basing chart = meaningful squeeze fuel if any subscriber datapoint stops getting worse
bearish_points: Core broadband keeps shrinking: -120k residential internet in Q1, -172k in Q2 2026; management only guides to eventual stabilization, not growth
Balance sheet is heavy: ~$96.7B debt, EV ~$119B, current ratio 0.36; deleveraging is slow and rates matter
Revenue growth is negative (-1.7% TTM) and 2026 trends were called weak; the cheapness is a value trap if subs accelerate down
Merger timing with Liberty Broadband adds overhang/complexity and one director sold ~$12.7M in May
catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings showing broadband net-loss deceleration/stabilization, continued mobile adds, and progress on the Liberty Broadband merger + buyback pace
catalyst_timing: Q3 2026 earnings ~Oct 30, 2026; merger close over coming quarters
suggested_trade: Spot starter now (~$150) with adds on a confirmed sub-loss inflection; longer-dated ITM calls (Jan 2027/2028) for leverage given IV is modest and buybacks provide a floor
key_risk: Broadband subscriber losses accelerate rather than stabilize, turning the low multiple into a permanent value trap as FCF gets consumed by debt service
would_skip_if: Q3 shows broadband losses widening again with no offsetting mobile/FCF strength, or the Liberty merger terms deteriorate
